help.en: The business problem the model is for, rated by the value it brings and how feasible it is.
What the business measures to see the effect, such as churn rate.
A named collection of data, such as a table or a set of files, with how often it is refreshed and how sensitive it is.
One input value a model learns from, with where it comes from.

constraints.message: = 'Feature "' + Name + '" does not say which dataset it comes from: connect it with "Derived from".'

help.en: A model in the registry: one prediction task, with its versions. Place it in the model registry.
How many versions of this model are registered.
A measured test of a model version on a test dataset, such as accuracy, fairness or speed. Passed compares the score with the threshold in the direction of the metric.

attributes.formula: Score == null || Threshold == null ? null : (Direction == 'Lower is better' ? Score <= Threshold : Score >= Threshold)

help.en: Yes when the score reached the threshold in the direction of the metric.
Passed, Failed, or Not run while the score or threshold is missing.

attributes.formula: (Metric ?? 'Score') + ' ' + (Score == null ? '-' : text(Score)) + (Direction == 'Lower is better' ? ', at most ' : ', at least ') + (Threshold == null ? '-' : text(Threshold))

help.en: The score and the threshold, shown on the diagram.

constraints.message: = 'Evaluation "' + Name + '" tests no model version: connect it with "Evaluates".'

help.en: A model version running in an environment where others can call it. Place it inside its environment.
The stage of the environment it sits in.
The model version that runs here.
Yes when the version that runs here passed its evaluations and was approved.

constraints.message: = 'Deployment "' + Name + '" is not inside an environment.'
= 'Deployment "' + Name + '" should run exactly one model version: connect the version with "Deployed as".'
= 'Deployment "' + Name + '" runs in production, but its model version has not passed every evaluation and been approved.'
= 'Deployment "' + Name + '" runs in production with no monitor.'

help.en: A watch on a running deployment that raises an incident when its signal, such as drift or latency, goes above the threshold.
The latest measured value of the signal.

attributes.formula: CurrentValue == null || Threshold == null ? null : CurrentValue > Threshold

help.en: Yes when the current value is above the threshold. The fill turns red.
The signal, its current value and the threshold, shown on the diagram.

constraints.message: = 'Monitor "' + Name + '" watches nothing: connect it to a deployment with "Monitors".'
= 'Monitor "' + Name + '" is above its threshold, but no incident was raised for it.'

help.en: A stage such as development, test or production. Place what runs there inside it.
A shared place that keeps features ready for training and for predictions. Place its features inside it.
A question tried out with training runs, all compared on one metric. Place its training runs inside it.
The metric the runs are compared on, such as AUC or error rate.
How many training runs sit inside.
The best score of the runs inside, in the direction of the metric.
The name and the best score, shown as the heading on the diagram.

constraints.message: = 'Experiment "' + Name + '" addresses no use case: connect it to one with "Addresses".'

help.en: One training of a model with given data, algorithm and parameters, and the score it reached.
The settings of this run, such as learning rate or tree depth.
What the compute for this run cost, in your currency.
The value of the metric of its experiment that this run reached.

attributes.formula: Score != null && parent != null && Score == parent.BestScore

help.en: Yes when this run has the best score in its experiment. Its fill turns green.

constraints.message: = 'Training run "' + Name + '" is not inside an experiment.'
= 'Training run "' + Name + '" does not say which data it trains on: connect it to a dataset or feature with "Trains on".'

help.en: The catalogue of models and their versions. Place the models and versions inside it.
One trained version of a model in the registry, with its stage, its evaluations and its approval.
The training run that produced it.
Passed when every evaluation of this version passed; Failed when one failed; Incomplete when one has no score yet.
Approved when every approval gate of this version approved it; Pending or Rejected otherwise.
Yes when it passed every evaluation and was approved.

constraints.message: = 'Model version "' + Name + '" should be a version of one model: connect it with "Version of".'
= 'No training run produced model version "' + Name + '", so where it came from is unknown.'

help.en: A decision by a person or board that a model version may go further, with the conditions attached.

constraints.message: = 'Approval gate "' + Name + '" is for no model version: connect it with "Approves".'
= 'Approval gate "' + Name + '" has a decision but no approver.'

help.en: Something that went wrong with a running model, such as drift or slow answers, and what is done about it.
What is done about it. Retrain needs an experiment or a training run that follows from it.

constraints.message: = 'Incident "' + Name + '" asks for retraining, but no experiment or training run follows from it: connect one with "Leads to".'

help.en: A model learns from a dataset or a feature.
A use case, agent or application relies on a model.
An evaluation tests a model or a prompt.
A model runs as a deployment.
A monitor watches a deployment or a pipeline.
The feature is calculated from the dataset.
The experiment works on the use case.
The training run produced the model version.
The version belongs to the model.
The approval gate decides about the model version.
The monitor raised the incident.
The incident led to a new experiment or training run.
How many training runs the model shows.
The compute cost of all training runs.
A use case with its data and features, experiments and training runs, model versions in a registry with their evaluations and approvals, deployments per environment, monitors and incidents.

rule_productionready.label: Warn when a version that is not ready moves to production

then.text: = '"' + Name + '" moved to production, but its evaluation is ' + EvaluationStatus + ' and its approval is ' + ApprovalStatus + '.'
